common_flow: Open Worknet or Work24 and search for the user query.
On results, identify job cards or table rows by title and company.
Visit visible unvisited postings in top-to-bottom order.
On detail, collect employment conditions and job description sections.

collection_policy.finish_condition: Requested trend sample size is reached or no unvisited rows remain.

known_pitfalls: Worknet and Work24 domains can both appear.
Result pages may be table-like rather than card-like, so row identity should include title and company.
